messages:
anya: Quick sync — we need a final cutlist for the Q2 MVP freeze. Constraints: infra team hit a memory regression on the embedding service and legal flagged multi-tenant SSO for more review. My strawman: MUST: core REST API, basic SSO (single-tenant), telemetry + rollout hooks; SHOULD: embeddings cache (best-effort, instrumented); NICE-TO-HAVE: tenant routing, advanced admin UI, multi-tenant SSO. Suggest we ship MVP without tenant routing and multi-tenant SSO and aim to include the embeddings cache only if we can get the infra patch in this sprint. Thoughts?

rio: +1 to the strawman. The memory regression makes embeddings risky if we don't pin quantization/KV cache changes. If we keep embeddings in MVP we need a rollback plan.

sam: UX warning — removing tenant routing breaks the admin on-boarding flow we demoed to acme last week. Can we ship a temporary flat-tenant flow so demos don't look broken? Small surface, 2-3 screens.

maria: Data note: recommendations performance drops ~18% without embeddings cache in our bench. If we defer it, we should add a telemetry flag to measure lift when we land it. Also we need to capture cold-start P95.

chris: Engineering trade: to keep embeddings in MVP we'd invest 3w (2p) to stabilize quantization and add eviction policy. Otherwise move embeddings to v1 and treat cache as a canary feature behind a flag. Either way we should do a canary rollout.

anya: Good — so options: A) ship MVP now with cache behind flag + strong rollback, B) cut cache to v1 and deliver flat-tenant admin patch for demos. Preference leaning B for predictability.

rio: If we pick B, infra can shift those 2w of work to the v1 sprint. But that implies pushing the internal milestone by 10 business days for integration tests. Not the entire release, just the internal readiness gate.

sam: For demos, we can fake the tenant routing UX by reusing the single-tenant flow and a small copy that toggles a dropdown. Low dev cost, keeps sales happy.

maria: Action item: if B, add a metric ticket: `embcache/deferred:baseline-ctr` and `embcache/on-rollout:ctr-lift` so we can measure delta when we enable.

chris: Can we get an infra patch ETA? If infra gives a patch by Wed (3 days), we could do A with the flag. If not, we go B. Also I need an explicit SLA target for the canary so I can set alert thresholds.

anya: I'll ping infra + legal. Decision rule: if infra confirms a safe patch and canary within 3 business days -> A, else -> B. SLA for canary: 95th p95 < 300ms for token generation and <1.5x current cost per token, otherwise immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: milestone:Q2-MVP readiness updated by anya — status: "cutlist-pending-decision".

anya: Next steps: (1) Rio to confirm infra ETA by EOD today, (2) Sam to scope 2-screen flat-tenant patch (estimate pls), (3) Maria to create the metric tickets, (4) Chris to draft rollback playbook and alert thresholds. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:30 for the final call. :thumbsup:
